_meta.note: content/events.json currently contains six invented 'upcoming' events and six invented 'past' events. None appear anywhere on the account. Note the org breaks for summer and reconvenes in September, so the window those fake events occupy is one the org has said it is dark for.

past.name: Voices for Rare Advocacy Breakfast
past.dateConfidence: approximate — post date; caption says 'this morning'
past.attendance: more than 80 patients, caregivers and supporters
past.description: The organization's first advocacy breakfast. Patients, caregivers and supporters from across Ontario shared stories and a unified message: Ontario's 1.3 million rare disease patients deserve a provincial strategy that meets their needs.
past.closingLine: Next year, we may need a bigger room.

past.description: Final meeting before the summer break.

cadence.note: Meetings pause over the summer and reconvene in September. The June 16 meeting was explicitly 'our final meeting before we break for the summer and reconvene in September.'

campaigns.name: Summer MPP outreach
campaigns.description: Encourages supporters to visit their MPP's constituency office or meet them at community events to share their story.
campaigns.copy: Summer is a GREAT time to connect with your local MPP! Whether you stop by their constituency office or meet them at a community event, taking the time to share your story can help build meaningful relationships and increase understanding of the challenges faced by the rare disease community. Every conversation matters.

advocacyFramework.name: Connecting Patients to Care
advocacyFramework.tagline: Every rare disease journey deserves timely diagnosis, treatment access, research, and support.
advocacyFramework.note: Taken from the organization's own infographic. A real five-stage framework that could replace the six invented advocacy commitments on the site.

stages.description: Accurate diagnosis for a faster path forward
Advancing science and innovation for rare solutions
Access to therapies and expert care when it matters
Better quality of life through connection, inclusion, and hope
